 Match Preview
 UEFA Nations League C - Game Week 6 Nov 15, 2026 - 06:00 Alphamega Stadium Cyprus host Montenegro at the Alphamega Stadium in Limassol in a UEFA Nations League C Group 2 fixture with direct implications for the top of the table.
 Montenegro arrive as group leaders, and Mirko Vucinic's side have been one of the most consistent teams in this Nations League cycle. They beat Latvia 2-1 on Matchday 5 to maintain their grip on first place.
 Cyprus sit second and come into this match off the back of a 1-1 draw with Armenia. Apostolos Mantzios's side had built real momentum earlier in the campaign, winning back-to-back games against Armenia and Latvia, but they were unable to hold on for a win in their most recent outing.
 These two sides have already met this cycle. Montenegro won 2-1 in Podgorica on September 25, giving Vucinic's squad a psychological edge heading into the reverse fixture.
 A win for Montenegro would put serious distance between themselves and Cyprus at the top. For the hosts, anything less than three points risks allowing the group leader to pull clear at a critical stage of the competition.
